text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorryyy! It's all my fault... 
Because of my miscommunication... the 
assistant hasn't arrived~~!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to apologize. However... 
hmm. We need at least one more person, 
otherwise...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh! If it isn't Trainer-san! What 
exquisite timing! Lend us a hand!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—And those are the cues for sound
effects. 
That is all you must do. Simple, is it 
not?

I respond while handling the audio 
equipment. Apparently, they were looking 
for extra hands for their puppet show.
choice_data_list: I-I think I sort of get how it wor...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bravo! Then let us begin the dress 
rehearsal! Let us perfect 'The Puppets' 
Odeon'!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Brava! Then let us begin the dress 
rehearsal! Let us perfect 'The Puppets' 
Odeon'!

text_block_list.name: Puppets
text_block_list.text:
"Sing of the stars~♪ Spin the wide
skies~♪ 
A world where friends abide~♪ Here is 
paradise~♪"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Doto? Doto!? ...Oh no! My friend! 
She's stopped moving!"

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"—Naturally! For the supreme sovereign 
ruler has ceased manipulating you all!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"M-Me...!? No way... A horse girl as 
beautiful as this exists beside 
myself...!?"
choice_data_list: (W-What kind of chaotic play is th...

text_block_list.text:
Even though it's a puppet show, they're 
acting as themselves and conversing with 
puppets! Yet thanks to the bizarre 
storyline, it never gets boring—

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent!
Have you had prior experience 
in sound engineering?
Please maintain this 
standard for the real performance!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us depart! To deliver the 
radiant light known as myself! —To the 
hospital!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes~... Actually, some time ago...
choice_data_list: A hospital...? Are you putting on ...
A hospital...? Are you putting on ...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I met a fan in town... That person works 
as a nurse...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
She was troubled because 'the children in 
the hospital have no entertainment.' 
Hearing that, Opera O-san said— 'My stage 
awaits.'

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...It's truly such a noble sentiment that 
it's an absolute honor just to help 
out...!!

Even if I'm just filling in, I resolve to 
give my all in assisting with the puppet 
show she prepared.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I have finally realized... You all 
made me see it. All that I ever wanted—"

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: "—was a friend."
(Waaaah—!!!) (Clap-clap-clap-clap!!)

The moment the final line is delivered, 
cheers and applause erupt from the 
children. —They felt they had witnessed 
something truly wonderful. That feeling 
radiated from everyone present.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah-hah-hah-hah! A resounding success, 
an absolute triumph! Well,
seeing as it is 
my production, that is only natural!!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! Indeed,
is it not! Is it not! Come, 
shower me with even greater praise!

I praise her not just for the excellence 
of the play, but for putting it together 
for the children,
including her charitable 
heart, but...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A charitable heart? What is that? I 
possess not a single shred of such a 
thing.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Indeed. That is so. After all—

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I merely did what is natural.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Why does a lighthouse exist? Why does the 
sun shine? Indeed, I merely shone 
dazzlingly bright for my own sake!!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For that purpose, I can achieve anything. 
It is as effortless as breathing. Not 
burdensome in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For that is the effort required for me to 
remain myself! In other words, what 
occurred today was...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The sun illuminating the world. —Merely 
that, and nothing more.

Overwhelmed by such a blindingly radiant 
philosophy, standing before a conqueror 
whose very soul is beautiful, few words 
could adequately reply—

I was completely overwhelmed by such a 
dazzling philosophy. Standing before the 
Supreme Overlord whose heart was equally 
beautiful, there were few words I could 
offer in return—

You truly are kind, aren't you?
I'm looking forward to your next p...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Hm.
Did my message not get across? As I 
said, it is not kindness, but—
choice_data_list: You really are kind, aren't you?
You truly are kind, aren't you?
I'm looking forward to your next p...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
choice_data_list: No, that's kind. Even if doing it ...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, fascinating! Truly fascinating, 
Trainer-san! To think you would interpret 
me in such a way!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I have taken quite a liking to you! 
How about it? Alongside the girl you 
currently train,
why not become my Trainer 
as well?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It seems you are already utterly 
captivated by my play. Ah, what a sinful 
soul I am...!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fear not, for of course I plan to stage a 
second and third performance as well. You 
may wait with high expectations!!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I shall never betray anyone's 
expectations!
